name: c0015-phase2
description: Operator-phase kill chain for session 1 (WS01): identity check -> the exact DFIR discovery set -> share probe (beacon-run, Medium integrity). The credential-access step (S7b) is OPERATOR-DRIVEN, not beacon-run: real Mimikatz requires an elevated token, so it runs via `runas /user:C0015\it.admin` -> mimikatz.exe on WS01 (creates the it.admin session in WS01 lsass first, then harvests it - see playbook). Lateral (WMI) and session 2 stay operator-interactive (explicit credential, prompt only).
